g.text: One Next.js deploy serves the patient LIFF web + the staff console.
Postgres is shared. LINE login + reminders are mocked behind one interface.
Solid = main flow Dashed = async / future Dotted = weak / planned
Today: patient lookup by phone (LINE userId later) - no staff auth on /staff -
Asia/Bangkok wall-clock slots - one dentist cannot be double-booked.
